title: scrophularia scorodonia var. glabrescens
intro: Scrophularia scorodonia var. glabrescens, commonly known as Woodland Figwort, is a plant species belonging to the Scrophulariaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Woodland Figwort are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Woodland Figwort, such as scrophularin and aucubin, are also responsible for its potential in treating respiratory issues, gastrointestinal problems, and other health conditions.
